data.name: AION Software Business Tools expansion
data.delivery: 16 KB XIP ROM system overlay / expansion cartridge
data.description: Separately offered 16 KB XIP ROM expansion cartridge with four applications: text editor, disk browser, calculator and calendar/scheduler. It calls TUI & services in the CP/M system cartridge. It does not contain a duplicate shared TUI library; application documents and state occupy RAM or disk storage.

subcomponents.name: Text editor
subcomponents.description: Own text documents and editor commands, using the system editing controls, screen services and clipboard.

subcomponents.name: Disk browser
subcomponents.description: Own disk/file browsing workflows, using system list controls, dialogs and file services.

subcomponents.name: Calculator
subcomponents.description: Own arithmetic operations and calculator state, using system input fields and clipboard services.

subcomponents.name: Calendar / scheduler
subcomponents.description: Own calendar records and scheduling workflows, using system forms, navigation and display services.

runtime_notes: The cartridge remains a 16 KB product capacity; removing duplicate routines does not establish a measured free-space budget.
Uses one cartridge slot alongside the CP/M system cartridge.
Code executes from banked ROM where practical; writable application state is held in RAM.
Reusable TUI widgets, screen and input primitives, clipboard ownership and workspace mechanisms belong to the CP/M system cartridge.
Application-specific text editing, file browsing, calculation and scheduling logic remain in this cartridge.
The applications call the system TUI interface; they do not require their own copy of its library.
A resident workspace reserves RAM explicitly; the cartridge does not imply multitasking.

system_dependencies.name: System TUI & services
system_dependencies.description: External dependency in the CP/M system cartridge: shared screen, input, editing controls, menus/forms, clipboard and workspace mechanisms.

portability_contract.shared_logic: Separate application/document algorithms from platform adapters.
portability_contract.display: Query dimensions and attributes; use semantic colors and clipping.
portability_contract.memory: Bounded buffers and handles for banked objects; report allocation failures.
portability_contract.storage: Versioned, explicitly encoded records; no persisted pointers or raw C structures.
portability_contract.migration: Recompile for the target, adapt OS-specific modules and test resource limits. This does not expand the listed supported platforms.
